title: Strict military-specific activity avoidance
description: Example profile that excludes confirmed military-specific activity while treating ambiguity as review material rather than guilt.

exclusions.description: Exclude confirmed claims that the contract subject itself is military-specific.

title: Narrow controversial-weapons focus
description: Example profile illustrating that a user may ignore ordinary Ministry of Defense contracts and reserve exclusion for a narrower evidence category not yet populated in the M1 pilot.

exclusions.description: Exclude only confirmed controversial-weapons involvement when such a narrow claim exists.

title: Transparency-first informational profile
description: Example profile that does not exclude military or political-finance evidence; it surfaces those claims for review and expresses a soft preference to avoid unresolved evidence in later portfolio construction.

exclusions.description: Show confirmed military-contract evidence for review without excluding it.
Show confirmed political-finance evidence for review without inferring ideology or excluding it.

preferences.description: Softly avoid unresolved human-rights evidence in future portfolio weighting; this is not an exclusion rule.
